name: binnacle
description: Binnacle's actions: product, daily, task, status, checkpoint and autopilot, driven through the binnacle MCP server, and audit, daemon, register and dashboard, which run the binn audit, binn daemon, binn project register and binn dashboard commands and need no daemon to be started; registering and the dashboard need a running daemon, and register and dashboard say so. dashboard shows the dashboard's address without its token.
